local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

for _, v in pairs(rs:GetDescendants()) do
    if v:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
        if string.find(v.Name:lower(), "win") or string.find(v.Name:lower(), "reward") then
            v:FireServer()
            v:FireServer(1)
            v:FireServer(true)
        end
    end
end
